import json
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
STATEMENT_INBOX_DIRECTORY = Path('/srv/billing/bank_statements/inbox')
STATEMENT_PROCESSING_DIRECTORY = Path('/srv/billing/bank_statements/processing')
STATEMENT_IMPORT_SCRIPT = '/opt/billing/bin/import_bank_statement.py'
BANK_ACCOUNT_REGISTRY_PATH = Path('/srv/billing/config/bank_accounts.json')

def stage_and_import_bank_statement(statement_filename, bank_account_code):
    # Look up the account in the bank account registry so the import gets its configured currency
    account_currency = None
    if BANK_ACCOUNT_REGISTRY_PATH.is_file():
        with BANK_ACCOUNT_REGISTRY_PATH.open('r', encoding='utf-8') as registry_file:
            bank_account_registry = json.load(registry_file)
        account_entry = bank_account_registry.get(bank_account_code)
        if account_entry is None:
            return {'ok': False, 'error': f'Unknown bank account code {bank_account_code}'}
        account_currency = account_entry.get('currency')
    sanitized_statement_name = Path(statement_filename).name
    incoming_statement_path = STATEMENT_INBOX_DIRECTORY / sanitized_statement_name
    if not incoming_statement_path.is_file():
        return {'ok': False, 'error': f'Statement {sanitized_statement_name} not found in inbox'}
    account_processing_directory = STATEMENT_PROCESSING_DIRECTORY / bank_account_code
    account_processing_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    staged_statement_path = account_processing_directory / sanitized_statement_name
    shutil.move(str(incoming_statement_path), str(staged_statement_path))
    import_command_arguments = ['python3', STATEMENT_IMPORT_SCRIPT, '--account', bank_account_code, '--file', str(staged_statement_path)]
    if account_currency:
        import_command_arguments += ['--currency', account_currency]
    completed_import_process = subprocess.run(import_command_arguments, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
    return {'ok': completed_import_process.returncode == 0, 'staged_path': str(staged_statement_path), 'exit_code': completed_import_process.returncode, 'stdout_tail': completed_import_process.stdout[-2000:], 'stderr_tail': completed_import_process.stderr[-2000:]}
